options.why: All widths and scaled rates are integers, so their products can be accumulated exactly.
Tier rates need not be equal, and equal rates would not justify dropping fractions tier by tier.
Fractional contributions from different tiers can together reach a whole unit; floor once after summing the exact numerator.
Bounds are sorted under the supplied contract; the error comes from premature rounding, not search ordering.

items.explanation: floor sums need not equal sum floors.
